content.name: Jasleen Gill
content.title: Project Coordinator
content.summary: Project coordinator at a Calgary civic construction firm, with a BBA from Mount Royal University and a co-op term in engineering project controls. CAPM-certified and working towards the PMP, I keep schedules, RFIs and meeting actions moving on recreation centre and library builds. Punjabi and English speaker who works well with crews, consultants and city staff.

experience.title: Project Coordinator
bullets: Coordinate documents and schedules for two municipal builds worth a combined $46 million, including a recreation centre expansion.
Track 400+ RFIs and submittals in Procore and chase overdue items so average response time dropped from 11 days to 7.
Take minutes and maintain action logs for weekly site meetings with the architect, the city and 12 trades.
Prepare the monthly progress report the project manager sends to the owner.

experience.title: Project Controls Co-op Student
bullets: Updated cost and schedule tracking for 18 small water and road design projects.
Built an Excel template for timesheet-to-budget comparisons that the controls lead adopted for all projects.
Helped prepare a bid package for a municipal stormwater contract that the firm won.

education.degree: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), Supply Chain Management

courses.name: Standard First Aid with CPR C

achievements.title: Co-op award
achievements.detail: Recognized by Nose Hill Engineering as the top co-op student of the 2023 cohort.

achievements.title: Student association
